notes.notes: Added leaderboards for the amount of garbage/caps

I've been wanting to add a minigun for a long time, and here it is, a new character!

Name: Butcher from Zone 12
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/09845b7ad8861438249219121d0ea8717b3d7bad.png[/img]

Description: A survivor from the depths of Zone 12. A taciturn butcher who collects trophies from the dead and turns scrap into weapons. His minigun knows no mercy, just like him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/5615602c957e673256fdf2d03764ad95afef86be.png[/img]

Weapon: "Minigun" - Fires a hail of bullets in front of him, piercing all enemies in his path.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/16bc20e34681917f942851e53edb025a231003a1.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Now you can disable lighting changes in the settings 
[*] Ranged bosses have become weaker

[list]
[*] Added dash (link with current move speed) on "space" (for keyboard), "right click" (for mouse) and "left trigger" (for gamepads)

[*] Minor balance changes
[/list]

[list]

[h1]New character[/h1]
Name: Aerofon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/fe52b077a1f41d7dcf91a53e95c2cfa191ec4ef4.jpg[/img]

Description: Aerofon is the result of experiments in atmospheric control. She is a mutant capable of generating powerful air currents that emanate from her body and spread in all directions. These currents create an invisible shield around her that pushes back anyone who gets too close, dealing minor damage and knocking them down. Aerophone prefers to keep her enemies at a distance, using her power to control the situation on the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/5d542fea791ee62be3d05842cf20814039076069.png[/img]

Weapon: "Air Barrier" - Aerophone creates powerful waves of air that knock enemies back, interrupting their attacks and dealing minor damage. The closer enemies are to Aerophone, the more they are knocked back. This skill makes her ideal for crowd control and defense against melee attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/e808e0321c472a5cae27e8851de4e088333492b9.gif[/img]

[h1]New Character[/h1]
Name: CryptoNomad Pavel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/77e36f9b901afdf085f41156be864404c6d56e20.jpg[/img]

Description: Pavel is a mysterious and elusive hero, a master of the digital world and a symbol of freedom in a post-apocalyptic world where information is power. He is always one step ahead, using his genius skills in cybersecurity and cryptography to confront those who try to limit freedom and control over information. As a hero of the resistance movement, Pavel is an inspiring leader who is not afraid to fight the system and defend everyone's rights to privacy and freedom.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/f95cd6efbda76cfc8028af5c2284e680ced29af3.png[/img]

Weapon: "Paper Airplane" - Pavel throws many paper airplanes in front of him, the airplanes bounce between enemies, causing minor damage and incapacitating opponents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44824092/f8b4baaed9258e14c37202db1f24552fcdee0395.gif[/img]
